resources.string: SentinelNet is a defensive network analysis and security auditing tool. Scanning networks or devices without the owner\'s permission may be illegal in your jurisdiction. You must be the owner of the network/device or have written authorisation. Active features are disabled by default in Safe Mode, require a fresh consent dialog, and every action is written to a local audit log.
